strongest_angle: Hyper-focusing on debt repayment can create significant financial vulnerability by depleting essential emergency cash reserves, leaving individuals exposed to unexpected costs.

key_facts.fact: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York reports that credit card debt held by Americans is currently near an all-time high as of October 2026.
The Gerald Financial Research Team warns that aggressive debt payoff strategies can drain emergency funds, leaving households vulnerable to unexpected expenses.
The California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation (DFPI) identifies an emergency fund as the primary tool for avoiding new debt when unplanned expenses arise.
